subject: note: The awful prospect that Blanchot so powerfully describes is that all the suicidal person experiences after the leap into the dark is the rope that ties them ever more tightly to the existence they wanted to leave.
note: As paradoxical as it might sound, the decision to end one’s life is a requirement of life in order to escape a life of indignity and incarceration, the life of the concentration camp.
